## Raising an Issue

Before opening an issue:
- Search existing issues to make sure it hasn't been raised already
- If it exists, comment on it instead of opening a duplicate

When raising an issue:
- Use the issue template provided
- Title format: `feat: [UI/UX] Short description` or `fix: [Bug] Short description`
- Be specific — vague issues will be closed
- If it's a bug, mention what you expected vs what actually happened
- If it's a feature, explain *why* it helps the user, not just what it does
- Don't paste AI-generated walls of text — keep it human and concise
- Do NOT start working on an issue until a maintainer assigns it to you

Good issue title examples:
- `feat: [UI/UX] Add loading state to commission request form`
- `fix: [Bug] Artist profile image not loading on mobile`
- `feat: [Frontend] Add character counter to brief input field`

Bad issue title examples:
- `bug in the site`
- `improvement needed`
- `help`

---
ISSUE TEMPLATE- 
name: Bug Report / Feature Request
about: Report a bug or suggest an improvement for Artery
---

# Problem
Describe the problem or limitation you are facing.

# Proposed Improvement
Explain the planned fix or improvement.

# Why this improvement is needed
Explain the benefit of this feature or fix.

# Expected Result
Describe the expected outcome after implementation.

# Alternatives Considered
Any other approaches you thought of and why you didn't go with them.

# Additional Context
Screenshots, screen recordings, or any other context here.
